CHAPTER.VERS: And in that day you shall say, O Jehovah, I will praise You; though You were angry with me, Your anger is turned away, and You comfort me.
Behold, the Mighty God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid; for YAH JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; He also has become my salvation.
And with joy you shall draw water out of the wells of salvation.
And in that day you shall say, Praise Jehovah! Call upon His name; declare His doings among the people, make mention that His name is exalted.
Make music unto Jehovah; for He has done excellent things; this is known in all the earth.
Cry out and shout, O inhabitant of Zion; for great is the Holy One of Israel in your midst!
